lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Long ~90 deg fold base plate A to flange B. Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the line point on the outer-skin apex of the rounded fold, with the nearest point 0.11-0.27 mm away along the whole length. The line is parallel to the fold and runs the full flange length, from the notch to the far part edge. Past the start (t=-0.1) the fold gives way to the notch and tab-C edge; past the end (t=1.1) there are no points. The round feature on flange B is an emboss or extruded hole wall, not a bend.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Short ~89 deg fold base plate A to slanted corner tab C. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer apex (nearest point 0.08-0.40 mm). The close-up seen along the bisector shows the line spanning the full tab width, about 9 mm, parallel to the fold. The ring around the hole in tab C is a hole or emboss wall, not a bend.
